The entitlement-gated upsell: what a tier adds, and purchase or redeem through the platform's store or Polaris Locker. It uses StoreKit on Apple platforms, Play Billing on Android and Locker elsewhere.

Where a purchase is not available in the app, the screen says so. **Buy in your browser** appears only when your app passes an https `offers.url` (a store or portal page). Without one, or with a link that is not https, the screen shows no button. In the web and React kits, set `offers.url` on the input. The other kits take the same link as the offers input's URL.

## In each kit

<Tabs syncKey="ui-kit">
  <TabItem label="SwiftUI">
    <KitStatus kit="swiftui" />

    **Drop-in.** Without a store, the hand-off to the browser and Redeem a code; the StoreKit store view follows.

    **Styled part.** `PaywallView(screen:features:onPortal:onRedeem:)`: the tier's features list under its includes line.

    **Headless.** `KitStates.paywall(_:)`: it never invents checkout.

    [SwiftUI](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/swiftui/) has the theme, the restyle hooks and the sample.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Electron">
    <KitStatus kit="electron" />

    **Drop-in.** A host places `<Paywall />` from `@polaris-key/react/kit`, given an `input`. Its **Buy in your browser** needs an https `offers.url`.

    **Styled part.** The React kit's `<Paywall />`, drawn in the macOS, Windows or GNOME chrome with `theme.platform: "auto"`; restyle through `data-part` and the `--pk-*` hooks.

    **Headless.** `viewOf("Paywall", input)`.

    [Electron](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/electron/) has the bridge, the menu and the sample.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Compose">
    <KitStatus kit="compose" />

    **Drop-in.** Inside `PolarisKitScreen`, which draws the Paywall for a `KitStates.resolve` answer. Without a store the screen offers the browser hand-off and Redeem a code; the kit computes no price.

    **Styled part.** `PolarisPaywall(screen, features, onUpgrade, onPortal, onRedeem, onDone)`: the tier's features under its includes line. Play Billing draws the purchase (`polaris-key-billing`).

    **Headless.** `KitStates.resolve(KitComponent.paywall, inputs)`; the offers input carries the https `offers.url` and the features.

    ```kotlin android
    import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
    import im.plrs.key.ui.KitComponent
    import im.plrs.key.ui.KitInputs
    import im.plrs.key.ui.KitStates
    import im.plrs.key.ui.PolarisPaywall

    @Composable
    fun MyPaywall(inputs: KitInputs, features: List<String>, openPortal: () -> Unit) {
        val screen = KitStates.resolve(KitComponent.paywall, inputs)
        PolarisPaywall(screen, features, onPortal = openPortal)
    }
    ```

    [Compose](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/compose/) has the one-liner, the sample and the routes; Compose Desktop opens the same screens in OS windows.

  </TabItem>
